provenance: Repository-authored synthetic negative test vectors for release signature tampering, untrusted signers, missing evidence, stale/replayed revisions, and provider secret ownership.

cases.description: Flipping one byte in the packaged Go engine binary must fail SHA-256 verification and block activation.
Modifying one byte in RELEASE.json must invalidate the signed release attestation.
Removing RELEASE.sig or SHA256SUMS.txt must fail closed before installation or upgrade.
An artifact signed by a wrong or untrusted Ed25519 key or signer identity must be rejected.
An expired release signature attestation cannot replace the accepted authority.
An older or replayed release revision cannot replace a newer accepted authority during upgrade.
Rolling back the binary or replaying an older backup must never overwrite or discard newer accepted metadata records.
Secret bytes remain sealed inside OpenBao; neither release artifacts nor local metadata stores contain plaintext secret bytes.
